Junie (2).description: While within 60' of you, any ally can use their own bonus action to grant themselves one of your Bardic Inspiration dice. Dice gained in this way have a +4 bonus when rolled.
Junie (2).upgrade: dice gained in this way have a +2 bonus/1

Bovo (3 - Influence?).description: Whenever you command an allied minion to make a weapon attack and the attack hits, it can then follow up with a second weapon attack that has disadvantage.
